desk.headline: Revenue up 27% to $545.3m on higher metal prices, above estimates; San Gabriel ramp-up delayed again; no formal guidance

numbers.eps_basis: IFRS, total net income per share

results: Revenue rose 27% to $545.3m and operating income rose 47% to $226.4m.
Copper output from its own mines rose 7%, but gold fell 6% and silver fell 21% (lower planned grades at Yumpag).
Processing at the new San Gabriel gold mine was held back most of the quarter by repairs to the tailings filter; it restarted in late September.
The company ended with $1.0bn cash and a net cash position of $307.3m, and approved a $0.5508 dividend per share.

guidance.summary: The results release gives no financial or production guidance. On the call, management pushed back San Gabriel's full ramp-up; an investor day on 10 Nov may bring 2027 guidance.

points: San Gabriel full capacity (about 3,000 t/day) is now expected by end-2028; filter repairs run to around April–May 2027.
Management said the processing plant, not the mine, sets San Gabriel's pace; steady-state cost estimate rose to about $180/t.
Dividends from the Cerro Verde copper stake are tracking $320–340m for 2026, with $200–250m pointed to for 2027.
Silver cash costs at Uchucchacua/Yumpag rose; a partial halt at Tambomayo may be reviewed in Q2 2027.
call.source: Buenaventura's Price-Driven Beat Overshadowed By Another San Gabriel Slip And A Softer 2027 Setup — Earnings Whispers (via Finviz), 30 Oct 2026

watch: San Gabriel throughput after the restart and progress on further filter work.
2027 guidance at the 10 November investor day.
Gold and copper prices, which drove this quarter's beat.
